entry.title: YOLO untuk Deteksi Objek: Catatan Awal
entry.content:
YOLO adalah keluarga model deteksi objek yang banyak digunakan karena pendekatannya relatif cepat dan praktis. Model ini memprediksi lokasi objek dan kelas objek dalam satu proses inferensi.

Kapan YOLO cocok digunakan?🔗

YOLO cocok untuk aplikasi yang membutuhkan deteksi cepat, seperti inspeksi visual, deteksi objek biologis, pemantauan lingkungan, sistem keamanan, dan prototipe computer vision berbasis web.

entry.title: What is Ovide Academy?
entry.content:
What is Ovide Academy?🔗

Ovide Academy is the personal academic website of Dr. Ovide Decroly Wisnu Ardhi. This website is developed as a space for sharing research notes, teaching materials, blog articles, books, and applied AI ideas.

The main focus of Ovide Academy includes applied artificial intelligence, computer vision, deep learning, academic writing, and digital education.

Why Ovide Academy?🔗

Ovide Academy is designed to become a personal knowledge hub. It connects academic research, teaching materials, and practical AI discussions in one website.

The website is especially focused on:

  • Applied Artificial Intelligence
  • Computer Vision
  • Deep Learning
  • Object Detection
  • YOLO-based Detection
  • Academic Writing
  • Digital Education
  • Books and Learning Materials

About Dr. Ovide Decroly Wisnu Ardhi🔗

Dr. Ovide Decroly Wisnu Ardhi is an Applied AI Researcher with interests in computer vision, deep learning, visual intelligence systems, academic writing, and digital education.

Through Ovide Academy, he shares academic notes, learning resources, and research-based ideas for students, researchers, educators, and general readers interested in applied AI.

entry.title: Image with Deep Learning
entry.content:
Image with Deep Learning

This book introduces image processing, deep learning, convolutional neural networks, and object detection.

It is designed as a learning resource for students, researchers, and early-stage practitioners who want to understand how deep learning can be applied to image-based problems.

entry.title: AI-Based Visual Analysis for Plankton Images
entry.content: Riset ini berfokus pada penggunaan deep learning untuk menganalisis citra mikroskopik plankton. Pendekatan visual AI dapat membantu proses identifikasi spesies, dokumentasi ekologis, dan pengembangan sistem pendukung keputusan berbasis citra.
